vulnerabilityRemediated.priorFlaw: Allocated a new 0-byte Buffer object and repointed local reference; original allocated heap buffer holding audio bytes remained unscrubbed until GC. Early return paths bypassed cleanup.
vulnerabilityRemediated.correctedMechanism: zeroAudioBuffer(audioBuffer) / buffer.fill(0) inside try ... finally block
vulnerabilityRemediated.correctedEffect: Directly overwrites underlying allocated binary heap memory with 0x00 across all exit paths.

Idempotent replay cache hit
exitPathsAudited.exitMechanism: Early return cached transcription record with 200 OK

exitPathsAudited.exitMechanism: Return completed transcript and metadata with 200 OK

exitPathsAudited.name: Unexpected runtime exception
exitPathsAudited.exitMechanism: Unhandled error caught by Fastify global error handler

mutableBinaryBufferScrubbing.guarantee: Immediate in-place zeroing of allocated Node.js binary Buffer memory.

immutableStringPrimitives.reason: V8 string primitives (e.g. input.audioBase64) are immutable in JavaScript user-space; reclaimed only via V8 GC sweep.
immutableStringPrimitives.mitigation: Short request lifecycle, ephemeral handling, no persistence.

jsonParserAstTokens.reason: Fastify / V8 internal HTTP parser token buffers are internal to the engine.

osSocketBuffers.reason: Kernel TCP receive buffers and OpenSSL TLS decryption buffers reside in OS kernel space.
osSocketBuffers.mitigation: Ephemeral TLS connections, no socket recording.
